content.title: Applying for a Permit with SMART License & Permits
content.summary: To apply for a permit using SMART License & Permits, users must first sign in or create an account by selecting \"Public\" and setting a username and password. New users can set up their accounts through the provided link, while returning users can log in directly to access their dashboard.
content.body:
**Attention**: You may need to complete and upload supplementary documents during the application process.

## Step 1: Sign in to SMART License & Permits

### New Users

- If you do not have an SMART License & Permits account, you will need to set up an account. To do so, you will need to select "Public" in the log in window and select a username and password.
- [Setup An Account](https://aca-prod.accela.com/ARVADA).

### Returning Users

- Sign in as a [Public User with your SMART License & Permits account](https://aca-prod.accela.com/ARVADA).
